## Mobix Labs Secures 1,500-Component Gulfstream Production Order


September 3, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.mobixlabs.com/node/9471/pdf)


**Repeat order reinforces Mobix Labs’ established position on active Gulfstream aircraft programs**


IRVINE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 3, 2026--[Mobix Labs, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.mobixlabs.com&esheet=54598346&newsitemid=20260903367160&lan=en-US&anchor=Mobix+Labs%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=0f40ddb5fa8e2b44eebf70cd6d5cf41c) (Nasdaq: MOBX), a U.S.-based provider of advanced electronic components and connectivity solutions for aerospace, defense and mission-critical applications, today announced that it has secured a repeat production order for approximately 1,500 mission-critical components for use on Gulfstream aircraft.


The order consists of EMI filtered connectors that protect sensitive onboard aircraft electronics from electromagnetic interference. It was placed by an existing aerospace customer supporting the Gulfstream platform and follows prior production orders for the same aircraft family.


“Repeat production orders are one of the strongest indicators of the value of a qualified aerospace position,” said Phil Sansone, Chief Executive Officer of Mobix Labs. “Our components have been designed into Gulfstream aircraft, have performed in service, and continue to generate follow-on production demand. This is exactly the type of recurring, long-duration aerospace business we are focused on expanding across Mobix Labs.”


**A Long-Term Position in Gulfstream Aircraft Production**


Mobix Labs’ filtered connectors are already integrated into Gulfstream aircraft systems. In aerospace, components that successfully complete the qualification process and are designed into an aircraft platform can remain part of that platform for extended production cycles, creating opportunities for recurring production orders as additional aircraft are manufactured.


The latest approximately 1,500-component order reinforces Mobix Labs’ position as a production supplier supporting active Gulfstream aircraft programs.


Gulfstream continues to operate at significant production scale. General Dynamics reported 79 Gulfstream aircraft deliveries during the first half of 2026. General Dynamics’ Aerospace segment also[reported approximately $24 billion in backlog](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.gd.com%2FArticles%2F2026%2F07%2F29%2Fgeneral-dynamics-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results%3Futm_source&esheet=54598346&newsitemid=20260903367160&lan=en-US&anchor=reported+approximately+%2424+billion+in+backlog&index=2&md5=374bbe02d6999d1e06873ae1caa57ae9) as of the end of the second quarter of 2026 and a 1.5-to-1 book-to-bill ratio for the quarter.


**Built for High-Reliability Aerospace Applications**


Mobix Labs’[EMI filtered connectors](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mobixlabs.com%2Fwhat-we-do%2Ffeatured-products&esheet=54598346&newsitemid=20260903367160&lan=en-US&anchor=EMI+filtered+connectors&index=3&md5=c815613aa34d8847aa43a1bad06d1962) help protect critical aircraft electronics from electromagnetic interference that can affect avionics, navigation, communications and other onboard systems. The Company’s filtered connector products incorporate specialized filtering technology and are manufactured in Irvine, California.


Mobix Labs’ components are deployed across a range of commercial aerospace and[defense applications](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mobixlabs.com%2Fwhat-we-do%2Fmilitary-defense&esheet=54598346&newsitemid=20260903367160&lan=en-US&anchor=defense+applications&index=4&md5=4b6f54222069cd3b5c964774af77eac7) , including Gulfstream aircraft, the F-22 Raptor, Apache helicopters, U.S. Navy shipboard secure communications systems, missile programs and certified onboard systems serving Boeing 737NG aircraft.


Mobix Labs continues to pursue additional qualified production positions across commercial aerospace and defense platforms as it expands its mission-critical electronics business.


**About Mobix Labs, Inc.**


Mobix Labs, Inc. (Nasdaq: MOBX) is a U.S.-based provider of advanced electronic components and connectivity solutions for aerospace, defense, communications and other mission-critical applications. Through its operating subsidiaries, including EMI Solutions and RaGE Systems, Mobix Labs provides technologies supporting commercial aerospace, military and other high-reliability applications. For more information, visit[www.mobixlabs.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.mobixlabs.com%2F&esheet=54598346&newsitemid=20260903367160&lan=en-US&anchor=www.mobixlabs.com&index=5&md5=160a1c482ff6de3b7374b0e88fe413e0) .
